usage: The word '鏡' (geng3) is used to refer to a mirror, an object typically used to see one's reflection.
'鏡' can be used in various contexts such as bathroom mirrors, makeup mirrors, or decorative mirrors in homes.
When used in a sentence, '鏡' usually functions as a noun, and can be combined with classifiers like '塊' (fai3) when counting mirrors.
It is common to see '鏡' paired with verbs such as '睇' (tai2, to look) or '拭' (sik1, to wipe), describing actions performed with a mirror.
'鏡' can appear in compound words and phrases related to various types of mirrors or reflective surfaces.
